facts.text: I am a solicitor and construction lawyer with more than 10 years experience specialising in construction law.
I regularly advise homeowners and builders and developers regarding their contractual and legal rights.
I represent homeowners and builders and developers in NSW, Australia as well as all courts of competent jurisdiction.
I have advised homeowners, builders, and contractors and developers regarding practical completion.
I have advised them on their contract rights, risks and obligations.
I have negotiated and amended contracts to reflect their intentions.

keyphrases: Importance of Practical Completion for Property Developers
Consequences of Failing to Meet Practical Completion
Tips for Ensuring Practical Completion is Met
